article.title: Organizing for the Long Haul Means Remaining Open Minded
article.author: Chris Dixon
article.content: One vital quality for staying involved in movements is openness. This is a willingness to consider that we might sometimes be wrong, an eagerness to learn from our mistakes, an ongoing sense of curiosity about the world, and a receptivity to new developments and ideas.
